items.title: Any website can pre-fill a payment to the attacker's account and trick the user into confirming
Server trusts the payee and amount that arrived in the deep link
A malicious app can register the same myapp:// scheme and capture or fake payment requests
Deep link reaches the payment confirmation screen without any re-authentication
Unauthenticated endpoint abused for resource exhaustion
A website can repeatedly force the payment screen open and make the app unusable
No record of where the payment request came from, so disputes cannot be resolved
